When she finally did, she sent the Helias Lady Crusaders to the Class 4 softball state championship game. Heckenkamp fouled off four pitches before she hit a 1-2 pitch on the outside corner between the first baseman and the second baseman for a two-out single. Allison Koofer-Thompson came around from second base to score the winning run, giving Helias a 2-1 walk-off win against the Platte County Lady Pirates in the state semifinals Thursday afternoon at Killian Softball Complex.
